headline_theorems.name: Recol.card_frozen
headline_theorems.statement: (B) for every n >= 1 with 3 | n: Nat.card {f : VH n -> Fin 6 // Frozen (Hn n) f} = 90 * 2^n

headline_theorems.name: Recol.frozenEquivPartitions
headline_theorems.statement: (B, explicit) for 3 | n: frozen colourings are in bijection with PairPartition x (ZMod n -> Bool); Recol.card_pairPartition: Fintype.card PairPartition = 90

headline_theorems.name: Recol.components_R6
headline_theorems.statement: (C) for every n >= 4 with 3 | n: 90 * 2^n + 1 <= Nat.card (RGraph (Hn n) 6).ConnectedComponent; frozen colourings are exactly the isolated vertices (Recol.frozen_iff_isolated)
